So the template splits into two fragments (maybe a disconnection). We need to continue with template 1914390 on one of those fragments. We tried matching 1914390 to both but got false. Maybe we need to apply 1914390 to the second fragment "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". It didn't match. Maybe the correct branch is the first fragment "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C". Let's test 1914390 on that.
